## 🎨 UX & Accessibility Checklist

- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Using correct tags (e.g., `<button>` for actions).
- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: Icon-only buttons and interactive elements have descriptive `aria-label` attributes.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: Focus states are clearly visible and tab order is logical.
- [ ] **Color Contrast**: Text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA/AAA standards.
- [ ] **Screen Reader Friendly**: Decorative emojis are hidden using `aria-hidden="true"`.
- [ ] **Responsive**: Interface works well on different screen sizes.
